subject: Issue: readland.tps: landmarks with negative values are important as NAs

messages.author: 2c733825cdd99eb4
messages.subject: Issue: readland.tps: landmarks with negative values are important as NAs
parts:
Hi There,

I am returning to an old dataset that I was able to read with "readland.tps" and analyse with "plotTangentSpace" last year without error.

Now it imports negative values as NAs and when I attempt to run plotTangentSpace I get the following error:

Error in plotTangentSpace(datasource, axis1 = 1, axis = 2, label = taxa,  : 
  Data matrix contains missing values. Estimate these first (see 'estimate.missing')

I have attached the file I am trying to read. It was generated using tps software. Digitised with tpsDig2, tpsUtil to append curves and generate slider file, and tpsrelw to align specimens.

Thanks in advance,
Andrew

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Issue: readland.tps: landmarks with negative values are important as NAs
parts:
Andrew, readland.tps is intended for reading landmark coordinates BEFORE superimposition. Because you have performed GPA in tpsRelW, you have negative numbers which are read into geomorph as NAs and appear as missing data. I suggest you try reading in your data before superimposition and then use gpagen to perform GPA inside geomorph, or you find some way other than readland.tps to read in your superimposed data.

Good luck!

Antigoni
